pages.text: Snow fell all night. The whole square was white.
The five decided to make snowmen. "I'll finish first."
Ppino scraped snow together in a hurry. No packing, just piling.
The four rolled snowballs. Round and round, bigger and bigger.
Ppino's snowman was already done. "All finished!"
Ppino stuck in branch arms. The body sank in.
The snowman collapsed. Only a pile of snow remained.
Grandma Bear pressed snow firmly with both hands. In her hands, the snowball grew solid.
Ppino rolled a snowball, pressing it firmly along the way.
Ppino's snowman was the biggest. The four tilted their heads back to look up.
